description: Verified point allocations for the pre-2010 JLPT, transcribed from the local official question-book scans. Canonical N3/N4 unit names in this file refer to old Levels 3/4, not modern N3/N4.
formula: round(sum(correct confirmed-key question weights) / sum(all confirmed-key question weights) * section maximum)
fallback_policy: Use the labelled historical-scale estimate for a paper or section absent from profiles. Do not extrapolate allocations across years. Questions without confirmed keys must be excluded from both numerator and denominator. A missing section is unavailable.
